summary: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints, allowing remote code execution.
recommendation: Upgrade to Apache Log4j 2.15.0 or later, or set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups to true.

summary: Path traversal flaw in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to map URLs to files outside the document root.
recommendation: Update Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later.

summary: OpenSSH through version 7.7 is prone to a user enumeration vulnerability due to differences in response times for authentication requests.
recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 7.8 or higher.

summary: Condition in ssh-agent PKCS#11 provider allows remote code execution when forwarded to an untrusted host.
recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 9.3p2 or later.

summary: 1-byte memory overwrite in Nginx DNS resolver allows remote attacker to cause denial of service or potentially arbitrary code execution.
recommendation: Upgrade Nginx to version 1.20.1 or 1.21.0 or later.

summary: Backdoor command execution in vsftpd 2.3.4 contains code that opens a shell on port 6200 when a username with smiley smiley face is entered.
recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd to version 3.0 or later or remove compromised package.

summary: Remote code execution flaw in Microsoft SMBv1 server (EternalBlue) allowing arbitrary code execution on target system.
recommendation: Apply Microsoft Security Bulletin MS17-010 and disable SMBv1.

summary: Remote Desktop Services remote code execution vulnerability (BlueKeep) allows pre-authentication remote code execution.
recommendation: Apply Microsoft security update for CVE-2019-0708 and enable Network Level Authentication (NLA).

summary: Spring Framework RCE via Data Binding on JDK 9+ allows remote attackers to obtain remote code execution via access to ClassLoader.
recommendation: Upgrade Spring Framework to version 5.3.18 or 5.2.20 or later.

summary: Elevation of privilege vulnerability in Netlogon Remote Protocol (Zerologon) allows unauthenticated domain compromise.
recommendation: Apply Microsoft update for CVE-2020-1472 and enforce secure RPC communications.

summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway.
recommendation: Update NetScaler to version 13.1-49.13 or newer build.

summary: Microsoft Exchange Server Server-Side Request Forgery vulnerability (ProxyLogon) allowing remote mail access.
recommendation: Apply Microsoft security updates for Exchange Server.

summary: OGNL injection vulnerability in Atlassian Confluence Server allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code.
recommendation: Upgrade Confluence Server to version 7.13.7, 7.18.05, or later.

summary: Heap-based buffer overflow in FortiOS SSL-VPN allows remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.
recommendation: Upgrade FortiOS firmware to version 7.0.12, 7.2.5, or newer.

summary: AJP protocol file inclusion and potential remote code execution in Apache Tomcat (Ghostcat).
recommendation: Upgrade Apache Tomcat to 9.0.31 or disable AJP Connector if not needed.
